theorems.name: Submission.dpf_pb_smooth_pullback_isTestForm
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (K' : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (α : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d), IsCompact K' → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ → (∀ x, x ∉ K' → ψ x = x) → IsTestForm α → IsTestForm (fun x => (α (ψ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ ψ x)) ∧ tsupport (fun x => (α (ψ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ ψ x)) ⊆ tsupport α ∪ K'
